title: Anthropic Revenue Hits $16.8 Billion in Quarter Before IPO
description: Anthropic PBC told prospective investors its third-quarter revenue hit $16.8 billion, according to people familiar with the matter, as the artificial intelligence model maker pushes ahead with plans to go public.

title: CreditSights Head of Strategy on Bond Market Volatility
description: Winnie Cisar, Global Head of Strategy at CreditSights, discusses the strain from heavy corporate borrowing, including debt tied to AI infrastructure. She said individual issuer problems such as CoreWeave’s may coexist with a broader surge in issuance that is challenging investors’ ability to absorb new debt. She speaks to Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Stocks Slide as Hot Inflation & AI Credit Fears Hit Markets
description: The Close brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Vanguard President & CIO Greg Davis, UBS Equity Research Analyst, Large-Cap Banks & Consumer Finance Erika Najarian, Janus Henderson CEO Ali Dibadj, CreditSights Global Head of Strategy Winnie Cisar, DoubleLine Global Sovereign & Emerging Markets Head Bill Campbell, Cisco Chair & CEO Chuck Robbins, Blackstone Global Head of Digital Infrastructure Mike Forman, Nuveen Global Head of Infrastructure Jessica Bailey, KKR Head of North American Infrastructure Brandon Freiman, Loop Capital Founder, Chairman & CEO Jim Reynolds, & Huel CEO James McMaster. (Source: Bloomberg)
